It is further ORDERED that if, after conferring in good faith, the parties are unable to resolve their discovery disputes, they should file a joint motion on the lead docket captioned "Joint Motion Requesting Status Conference" on or before 9:00 a.m. on October 31, 2026. In any such joint motion, the parties shall provide a brief description of each issue in dispute, set forth each party's respective position (no more than two paragraphs per party per issue), and append any relevant documentation. If such a motion is filed, the parties shall further provide their joint availability for a status conference on October 31, 2026, November 1, 2026, and November 2, 2026. Signed by Judge Loren L. AliKhan on 10/30/2026. (lclla3)
